description: FREE, read-only. Returns the advertised x402 payment terms for a `who` lookup — price, asset, network, payee, and the source's coverage statement — without paying anything and without needing a wallet. Use this before `who` to decide whether the lookup is worth the money (currently $0.05 USDC on Base mainnet). If the subject is malformed, missing or ambiguous, this returns that free refusal instead of terms, which means `who` would also cost nothing.

q.description: Company name, registrable domain (apple.com), or 20-character LEI. Append a jurisdiction to disambiguate a name: "Acme Corp;US-DE".
